scope: Current Vite guide V5: isolated B source copy, actual npm installation, service development server and fresh Chrome UI. Product sources, dist, dev kits and active composition are not changed.
limitations: This run starts with a newly created empty npm cache and downloads from the public npm registry. The bundled build-tool tarball and published SDK/D dev kit are intentionally supplied with the service project.
Playwright comes from the original integration installation only as a test harness; the copied service has no sibling source or server dependency.
This script checks development only. Build/publication/activation/rollback are covered by the separate release walkthrough.

checks.name: copy one B service with its published dev kit and no sibling sources
npm ci installs the isolated Vite project from the declared cache mode
the standalone development page loads SDK 1.3.1, B 1.4.0 and D 1.0.0 through actual MF requests
counter, input and cache can be used on the rendered service
saving the copied source rebuilds B and performs a full reload that resets state
a syntax error keeps the previous successful screen, counter, input and cache
removing only the invalid line restores the successful source and clears the overlay without discarding state
restore the original Car Picker source and confirm the original development build before stopping
the walkthrough needs no other service server and reports no browser runtime exception

evidence.expectedFailure: One deliberately invalid copied JSX build; UI remained available.

checks.name: the development server stops and the original service and product pointer are unchanged

findings.observation: Removing only the deliberately invalid line restores exactly the previous successful source, so the development build ID is unchanged; the error overlay clears without a reload and the previous input/counter/cache remain. A real successful source change creates a new ID and reloads, as checked earlier.
